current_concerns.primary_problems: I spend a great deal of time calculating and counting calories, and I become anxious if I do not have a meal plan. This takes up much of my day and interferes with my concentration at work because my thoughts remain focused on food. I also avoid eating with other people.
current_concerns.goals: Reduce the amount of time spent thinking about and planning food in advance; be able to eat with friends without thinking about it several days beforehand; and avoid organizing the entire day around food.
